rules.disposition: Compare with the unfiltered rendering a missing reference requires.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to the adjacent image when it draws the element without any filter function applied.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering; the archived image applies the functions around the missing reference.

rules.disposition: Compare with the unfiltered rendering a missing reference requires.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to the adjacent image when it draws the element without the filter.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering; the archived image hides the element whose filter reference is missing.

rules.disposition: Compare on a transparent canvas, with the circle geometry covered by independent controls.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to an adjacent image with a transparent background that passes at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner renderings; the archived images are opaque white where the canvas is transparent.

rules.disposition: The caller canvas preserves user units for a root without intrinsic size.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to the adjacent image if the harness supplies the 200-unit initial viewport the archived image was made with.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering at the caller canvas; the archived image shows a 200-unit viewport scaled 2.5 times.

rules.disposition: The XML parser accepts UTF-8 bytes.
rules.removal_criteria: Compare after the parser supports the authored input encoding or the fixture is transcoded and its declaration agrees.
rules.reference_provenance: Archival corpus PNG for a different input or viewport policy.

rules.disposition: Compare on a transparent canvas, with host style inheritance covered by an independent control; the archived glyph rasterization is heavier.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to an adjacent image with a transparent background that passes at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering; the archived image is opaque white and its glyph ink is about 5.6% heavier.

rules.disposition: Preserve the SVG 2 font presentation-attribute contract.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to the adjacent image when it ignores the font attribute at the explicit canvas size.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering; the archived image applies the SVG 1.1 font presentation attribute.

rules.disposition: Compare against the Donner rendering whose glyph ink equals the outline area.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an adjacent reference whose glyph ink matches the outline area and that passes at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner CPU rendering; the vendored PNG draws glyph edges 0.25 to 0.3 px outside the outline.

rules.disposition: Compare against the Donner rendering whose glyph ink equals the outline area.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an adjacent reference whose glyph ink matches the outline area and that passes at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner CPU rendering; the vendored PNG draws glyph edges 0.25 to 0.3 px outside the outline.

rules.disposition: Keep identity semantics.
rules.removal_criteria: Use the adjacent image when it preserves an independently checked identity ramp at default limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Project identity golden with the unfiltered ramp as an independent control; archive quantizes linear RGB.

rules.disposition: Retain the smallest verified allowance for the archived color step.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the allowance when an independently computed high-precision matrix reference passes on CPU and Geode.
rules.reference_provenance: Archived eight-bit linear RGB samples, with constant-channel/matrix controls.

rules.disposition: Retain the measured allowance around the skewed ramp.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove after a reference independently reproduces the transformed ramp and full image at default limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Archived reference shades the ramp before skew.

rules.disposition: Retain the measured allowance around the skewed point light.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove after a reference reproduces the point-light metric and full image at default limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Archived reference evaluates the light before skew.

rules.disposition: Keep the existing spotlight image qualified by the independent full-scene model and hard-cone control.
rules.removal_criteria: Use the adjacent reference when it agrees with the independent 500-pixel scene and the documented transformed lighting and soft cone at ordinary settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Existing project image independently reproduced from the fixture geometry and the documented renderer convention, with at most one visible RGBA code of error.

rules.disposition: Retain the measured coverage allowance.
rules.removal_criteria: Use default settings after a compared independent blur control agrees under the transform.
rules.reference_provenance: Archived blur is applied before skew.

rules.disposition: Use the documented analytic edge coverage for Geode.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the Geode override after a shared reference preserves total covered area and passes both CPU and GPU.
rules.reference_provenance: Backend golden for independently measured analytic coverage spread by a directional blur.

rules.disposition: Preserve original filter samples and outlined labels.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an upstream image when it agrees on both filter colors and pinned-font label coverage.
rules.reference_provenance: Original filter pixels with independently outlined labels and per-backend coverage.

rules.disposition: Keep the verified fractional displacement.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the override when an upstream image preserves the authored fractional offset and halo at default limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Project comparison references qualified against authored and measured shadow offsets.

rules.disposition: Keep the independent clipped-source and blur edge invariant.
rules.removal_criteria: Replace the project golden when the adjacent reference includes the correct blur spill at the hard region edge.
rules.reference_provenance: Project golden supported by the independent blur control.

rules.disposition: Keep the shared independently clipped-input blur reference at ordinary settings.
rules.removal_criteria: Use adjacent references when they preserve opaque blur input and the correctly inherited hard filter bounds at ordinary settings.
rules.reference_provenance: resvg 0.49 rendering of the expanded and independently clipped input with a padded blur and post-clip.

rules.disposition: Keep the independent filter-input clip and narrower primitive-output clip at ordinary settings.
rules.removal_criteria: Use the adjacent reference when it retains opaque source alpha and clips the narrower primitive result after blurring.
rules.reference_provenance: resvg 0.49 rendering of the explicitly clipped input, padded blur, and separate 100-unit output clip.

rules.disposition: Preserve equality of the live BackgroundImage and BackgroundAlpha coverage.
rules.removal_criteria: Compare normally after independently regenerating the equal-alpha blur edge at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: The archived alpha blur reaches full coverage two pixels later.

rules.disposition: Use the independently placed half-box clip.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to the adjacent image once it preserves the independently verified bounding-box clip and aligned crosshair.
rules.reference_provenance: Geometry-derived half-box reference on a canvas with an integral crosshair.

rules.disposition: Compare the authored tile periods, clipping and transforms, drawn as explicit geometry.
rules.removal_criteria: Retire the override when upstream reproduces the independently qualified clipped and positioned tile geometry at default limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Independent 500px resvg v0.49 rendering of explicit authored tile geometry, with positive and shifted controls.

rules.disposition: Compare the authored tile periods, clipping and transforms, drawn as explicit geometry.
rules.removal_criteria: Retire the override when upstream reproduces the independently qualified clipped and positioned tile geometry at default limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Independent 500px resvg v0.49 rendering of explicit authored tile geometry, with positive and shifted controls.

rules.disposition: Keep the documented sharp tile seams, which Donner's 2x tile raster with bilinear sampling reproduces at these tiles' alignment, and the circular-layer disposition.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the override when the adjacent PNG preserves the sharp seams and the proven recursion behavior.
rules.reference_provenance: Project goldens after independently measuring tile strokes, clipping and circular references.

rules.disposition: Keep the measured 442 Metal and 449 Vulkan edge residual within the Geode-only bound.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove when the same 0.8x thin-stroke image matches both independent coverage and the ordinary shared allowance.
rules.reference_provenance: Adjacent reference with analytic sampling differences on nested SVG boundaries; explicit placements and a half-unit shift control isolate the residual from marker placement.

rules.disposition: Require zero threshold and zero mismatched pixels.
rules.removal_criteria: Keep the strict seam check unless an independently equivalent exact assertion replaces it.
rules.reference_provenance: Vendored image compared through the strict seam invariant.

rules.disposition: Map paint through SVG glyph cells.
rules.removal_criteria: Retire the browser reference when upstream preserves glyph-cell mapping and passes at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Firefox renders qualified with the pinned Noto Sans glyph cell geometry.

rules.disposition: Keep the deterministic nested font catalog.
rules.removal_criteria: Use the adjacent reference when it is drawn with the same nested-document font and passes at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Project reference with embedded-font and independent browser controls.

rules.disposition: Preserve the supported vertical hanging baseline.
rules.removal_criteria: Use the adjacent image when it demonstrates the independently measured vertical baseline.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering checked against the font vertical advances.

rules.disposition: Preserve the shaped advance and adjusted size.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the override when upstream matches the independent size and kerned pen-width measurement at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Project reference backed by measured font metrics and shaped anchoring.

rules.disposition: Keep the chosen CSS Fonts 4 absolute-size table.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an upstream image rendered with the same accepted table and fixed font at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Project font-size references supported by independent browser and metric controls. The named-value frame uses the independently rendered exact-area witness.

rules.disposition: Retain the measured simple-tier coverage allowance for synthetic small caps. The exact corpus face selects different native small-cap glyphs in full text.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove after the simple engine supports native smcp and both explicit and inherited fixtures pass at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Adjacent native-small-cap references with the bundled Noto Sans face. Independent HarfBuzz selection with smcp produces e.sc, x.sc and t.sc for Text, while the simple tier scales uppercase outlines.

rules.disposition: Keep the authored chunk anchors on the transparent comparison canvas.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to a transparent upstream image with independently verified y-only chunk anchoring at the default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Project reference qualified against matched-coverage and browser geometry controls.

rules.disposition: Compare three explicit bands with the renderer's multiline spacing policy and original paint order.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an independently reproduced adjacent reference that preserves the same multiline placement and paint order.
rules.reference_provenance: resvg v0.49.0 render of literal bands derived from Noto Sans metrics and HarfBuzz advance at 800px.

rules.disposition: Keep the archived 500px scene with a 0.09 color threshold and the ordinary pixel limit.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the allowance when a pixel reference preserves declaring-span fill and stroke and matches the chosen raster coverage at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: The origin-paint control preserves the child colors. At 800px its supersampled edge rounds 20% to 25%, unlike analytic rectangle coverage.

rules.disposition: Keep the archived 500px scene with a 0.03 color threshold and the ordinary pixel limit.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove once an independent rotated-glyph gradient mapping and decoration reference agree at default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: The archive maps its horizontal gradient across approximately 246.5 device pixels; the current rendering spans 230.8.

rules.disposition: Keep the composed cluster at the first y value.
rules.removal_criteria: Replace after an independent unchanged-input reference skips the interior y and passes at the default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Independent resvg v0.49.0 scene at 800px with the bundled Noto Sans face and the precomposed Cyrillic glyph at the first y.

rules.disposition: Keep the authored codepoint addressing of the joined cluster.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to an unchanged-input reference with complete emoji clusters at the independently verified baselines and ordinary limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Independent resvg v0.47 with explicit cluster spans and bundled Noto Color Emoji.

rules.disposition: Keep full text and the independently reproduced image sampling allowance.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the allowance after the pinned bitmap font rendering agrees at ordinary threshold across supported CPU builds.
rules.reference_provenance: Official resvg v0.49 render of unchanged corpus SVG with the bundled Noto Color Emoji face.

rules.disposition: Keep the documented guide and glyph sampling allowances.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the allowance when an independently placed reference passes unchanged at ordinary limits.
rules.reference_provenance: Adjacent archive with a different glyph-boundary and gray-guide coverage model.

rules.disposition: Compare the CPU lanes with Donner's arc-length placement and Geode with the release reference.
rules.removal_criteria: Compare with the vendored reference when it places glyph midpoints at their exact distance along the path.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner TinySkia rendering for the CPU lanes; the resvg v0.50.0 release reference, which inverts arc length to within 0.5 user units, for Geode.

rules.disposition: Retain the independent text-path placement reference.
rules.removal_criteria: Remove the override when the adjacent file encodes the same independent path placement.
rules.reference_provenance: resvg v0.47 reference with reproduction inputs recorded.

rules.disposition: Keep the path-warp regression and independent straight-path invariant.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an upstream image after it depicts stretch deformation and passes alongside the independent straight-path control.
rules.reference_provenance: Project reference for path-relative deformation; the archived PNG depicts align placement.

rules.disposition: Preserve geometric path-end continuation.
rules.removal_criteria: Use an upstream equivalent once the reference restarts text from the path endpoint and passes independent geometry controls.
rules.reference_provenance: Project references with independent path-end and whitespace geometry qualification.

rules.disposition: Keep the documented absolute-position and underline regressions.
rules.removal_criteria: Qualify independent full-scene path position and decoration geometry before replacing the project reference.
rules.reference_provenance: Project regression goldens with focused semantic controls.

rules.disposition: Preserve SVG 2 path geometry and transparent output.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch when upstream can render the path attribute independently on a transparent canvas with default settings.
rules.reference_provenance: Project references qualified against independently measured browser geometry.

rules.disposition: Compare with upright glyphs at the font vmtx origin.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to the adjacent image when it uses the font vertical metrics for upright glyphs on the path.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner rendering; the archived image moves upright glyphs off the font vmtx origin.

rules.disposition: Use the font vertical metrics CSS Writing Modes 3 requires for upright glyphs.
rules.removal_criteria: Switch to an adjacent reference when it reproduces the documented vertical metrics and punctuation forms.
rules.reference_provenance: Donner renderings checked against the font vertical metrics.
